```{r setup, include=FALSE}
x <- 1:4
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

This article collects R results with our renderer. The mean is `r mean(x)`.
The equation $y = x^2$ and the research citation [@smith] accompany a
note^[Chunks share state within this article.].

## Results

```{r table, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
knitr::kable(data.frame(x = x, square = x^2))
```

```{r figure, echo=FALSE, fig.cap='Squares of the input values.', fig.alt='Four points increasing from one to sixteen'}
plot(x, x^2, xlab = "Input", ylab = "Square")
```
